lyrics.ja: みなさん～こんにちは～！

lyrics.en: Let's all get pumped up together!

lyrics.ja: Hi！ Hi！ 3.2.1GO！
lyrics.en: Hi! Hi! 3, 2, 1, GO!

lyrics.ja: あーっ！大発見！
lyrics.en: Ah! What a discovery!

lyrics.ja: ココロがノーツとシンクロしてる
lyrics.romaji: Kokoro ga Nootsu to Shinkuro Shiteru
lyrics.en: My heart is syncing with the notes

lyrics.ja: (ドキドキドキドキ)
lyrics.en: (Pounding, pounding, pounding, pounding)

lyrics.ja: 赤青黄色　星もあるね？
lyrics.romaji: Aka Ao Kiiro Hoshi mo Aru ne?
lyrics.en: Red, blue, yellow—there are stars too, right?
lyrics.zh: 紅的藍的黃的，還有星星呢？

lyrics.ja: あーっ！大事件！
lyrics.en: Ah! What an incident!

lyrics.ja: ココロがグルグル騒いじゃってる！
lyrics.en: My heart is spinning and making a fuss!
lyrics.zh: 心臟咕嚕咕嚕地騷動不停！

lyrics.ja: (ぐるりぐるりぐるりぐるり)
lyrics.en: (Round and round and round and round)

lyrics.ja: あれあれ目が回っちゃうにぇ！(うわーっ！)
lyrics.romaji: Are Are Me ga Mawatchau Nye! (Uwaa!)
lyrics.en: Oh no, oh no, I'm getting dizzy! (Whoa!)
lyrics.zh: 哎呀哎呀，要眼花撩亂了喵！（哇啊！）

lyrics.ja: キンコンカーンコーン
lyrics.en: Ding dong, ding dong

lyrics.ja: 放課後はスキップのリズムで

lyrics.en: After school, with a skipping rhythm
lyrics.zh: 放學後用輕快蹦跳的節奏

lyrics.ja: その後はやっぱちょい早めで
lyrics.romaji: Sono Ato ha Yappa Choi Hayame de
lyrics.en: And after that, a little bit faster
lyrics.zh: 之後果然要稍微加快一點

lyrics.ja: いーじゃん！(いーじゃん？)

lyrics.ja: いーじゃん！！(いーじゃん！！)
